Proves the predicate reads the LATEST row, not 'any row' (deliberate start-review-while-extraction-runs behavior).

Case (b): latest row = NON-zero-criteria failure — 'Job description is blank', 'Failed to parse AI response: x', arbitrary StandardError message. Each: row-level zero_criteria_failure? false, predicate false, neither validator blocked by the zero-criteria message. Case (c): c1 latest succeeded (with criteria) -> predicate false, not blocked. c2 succeeded row NEWER over an OLDER zero-criteria failed row -> old row IS zero_criteria_failure? at row level, latest is the succeeded row, predicate false, not blocked.
